description: This file contains helper functions for health check operations in a machine learning/language model utility project. It includes static methods for running health check models, updating request parameters with tracking info, getting metadata, and providing mode handlers for different health-related operations.

classes.name: HealthCheckHelpers
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to assist with health check model calls, parameter updates, metadata retrieval, and mode handler functions for various health check operations.

methods.name: dict ahealth_check_wildcard_models( model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, model_params: dict, litellm_logging_obj: "Logging", )
methods.description: Asynchronously selects a model from the provider, sets up parameters, runs a completion, and returns an empty dict. Used for health checking wildcard models.

methods.name: dict _update_model_params_with_health_check_tracking_information( model_params: dict, )
methods.description: Updates model parameters with tracking information including tags and user API key authentication details.

methods.name: _get_metadata_for_health_check_call()
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for the health check call, primarily returning tags.

methods.name: Dict[Literal["chat","completion","embedding","audio_speech","audio_transcription","image_generation","video_generation","rerank","realtime","batch","responses","ocr",],Callable,] get_mode_handlers( model: str, custom_llm_provider: str, model_params: dict, prompt: Optional[str] = None, input: Optional[list] = None, )
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of mode handler functions for various health check operations, including chat, completion, embedding, audio, image, video, rerank, realtime, batch, responses, and OCR modes.
